summary: Work-order body vs. acceptance mismatch inside the card itself: the spec body says to take the letter at index 1 (left) / index 2 (right) and "插入到下标 13" (insert at index 13), but the card's own pinned acceptance vectors (e.g. chaocipher_encrypt("HELLOWORLD") == "WAHQVICHTD", chaocipher_encrypt("CHAOCIPHER") == "QTLVOFOEYS") cannot be produced by a literal lst.insert(13, lst.pop(k)) reading — that reading yields WAHQZIUETS / QTLVOFTEYS. The vectors require the removed letter to land before the element originally at index 13 (post-pop insert at index 12). Neither the process card nor plan.json addresses or resolves this contradiction; the worker implemented the acceptance-satisfying variant.
evidence: packs/chaocipher/handoff.md, section "Validator must pay attention to": "**Permutation index deviation (important).** The card's literal wording ... does NOT reproduce the pinned acceptance vectors ... The acceptance section states 验收要点逐字为准, and the pinned ciphertexts require the removed letter to land *before* the element originally at index 13, i.e. `lst.insert(12, lst.pop(k))`" (status.json does not flag it).
